audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with Exodus/plague/trumpet imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for seventh seal silence, incense prayers, first four trumpets, eagle warning.

verses.restored: When he opened the seventh seal, silence happened in heaven about half an hour.

familiar.text: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

verses.restored: And I saw the seven messengers who stand before the Divine, and seven trumpets were given to them.

familiar.text: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

verses.restored: Another messenger came and stood at altar, having golden censer; much incense was given to him, so he might give it with prayers of all holy ones upon golden altar before throne.

familiar.text: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

verses.restored: The smoke of incense with prayers of holy ones went up before the Divine from hand of messenger.

familiar.text: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.

verses.restored: The messenger took the censer, filled it from fire of altar, and cast it to earth; and thunders, voices, flashes, and shaking happened.

familiar.text: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

verses.restored: And the seven messengers having seven trumpets prepared themselves to trumpet.

familiar.text: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

verses.restored: The first trumpeted, and hail and fire mixed with blood/life came, cast to earth; a third of earth and trees were burned, and all green grass burned.

familiar.text: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

verses.restored: The second trumpeted, and something like great mountain burning with fire was cast into sea; a third of sea became blood/life.

familiar.text: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

verses.restored: A third of creatures in sea having life died, and a third of ships were destroyed.

familiar.text: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

verses.restored: The third trumpeted, and a great star fell from heaven, burning like torch, upon a third of rivers and springs of waters.

familiar.text: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

verses.restored: Name of star is called Wormwood; a third of waters became wormwood, and many humans died from waters because they were made bitter.

familiar.text: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

verses.restored: The fourth trumpeted, and a third of sun, moon, and stars were struck, so a third of them darkened, and day did not shine for a third of it, and night likewise.

familiar.text: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.

verses.restored: And I saw and heard one eagle flying in mid-heaven, saying with great voice: Woe, woe, woe to those dwelling on earth, from remaining trumpet voices of three messengers about to trumpet.

familiar.text: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

translation_notes: Trumpets echo Exodus plague imagery and should be read as symbolic warning/exposure, not literal prediction charts.
Prayers of holy ones precede trumpet judgments; worship and witness remain central.
safety_note: Do not use trumpet images for date-setting or fearmongering. They are apocalyptic signs of creation and empire under judgment.
